name: Muhammad Rasya Islami
title: Web Developer & Robotics Enthusiast
about: I am an Information Systems undergraduate student at Institut Teknologi Sepuluh Nopember (ITS) who bridges technical adaptability with organizational leadership. I specialize in AI-assisted Vibe Coding and modern web platforms, alongside a strong passion for robotics, microcontrollers, and hardware integration. Beyond technical execution, my background leading student organizations drives my ability to coordinate cross-functional teams and manage complex projects. I am always open to exciting collaborations and internships where I can build impactful digital realities.
